OwnerAcceptanceContributionBinding.description:
Server-resolved numeric GitHub contributing identities for a reviewed range.

Launchplane resolves these from trusted pull-request and GitHub-linked commit
evidence. Unresolved or conflicting evidence is recorded as ``unknown`` with no
identities so self-review and admissibility fail closed.
OwnerAcceptanceContributionBinding.title: OwnerAcceptanceContributionBinding

OwnerAcceptanceEventSemantics.description:
Machine-readable projection of a stored human product-review action.

The stored enum and every persisted digest stay unchanged. This projection
exists so no API client can read Owner product review as merge readiness,
landed state, or production authorization.

authorizes.description: Always empty. Owner product review authorizes nothing on its own.
authorizes.title: Authorizes

OwnerAcceptanceEventSemantics.title: OwnerAcceptanceEventSemantics

OwnerAcceptancePolicyFingerprintBinding.description: Product/action-scoped, explicitly versioned Owner policy fingerprints.
OwnerAcceptancePolicyFingerprintBinding.title: OwnerAcceptancePolicyFingerprintBinding

OwnerAcceptancePreviewIsolationBinding.description:
Recorded preview data/credential isolation class for the reviewed evidence.

L1 product judgment is never a security control. This binding exists so weak or
unknown preview isolation makes the recorded review inadmissible rather than
silently trusted.
OwnerAcceptancePreviewIsolationBinding.title: OwnerAcceptancePreviewIsolationBinding

OwnerAcceptanceReviewContext.description:
Exact reviewed context bound to one Owner product-review event.

The context is entirely server-resolved. It never grants merge or release
authority; it exists so historical evidence can be judged currently admissible
using bound base identity, impact class, authorship, finite age, scoped policy
fingerprints, and preview isolation.
OwnerAcceptanceReviewContext.title: OwnerAcceptanceReviewContext

bindings.description: Viewer-specific advisory eligibility for exact product bindings. Missing or ineligible bindings must not expose event controls. Event writes revalidate the exact binding and current product Owner authority independently.
bindings.title: Bindings

event_write_authorized.description: Whether the evaluated identity currently has route-level owner_acceptance_event.write authorization. Browser session and current product Owner authority are revalidated separately when an event is submitted.
event_write_authorized.title: Event Write Authorized

ProductOwnerPreviewTrustPolicy.description: Minimum provable preview isolation for admissible Owner review evidence.
ProductOwnerPreviewTrustPolicy.title: ProductOwnerPreviewTrustPolicy

ProductOwnerReviewAgePolicy.description:
Finite Owner-review evidence age, scoped to one product Owner policy.

``elevated_max_age_seconds`` covers sensitive, unknown, and
production-affecting changes. Policies may only choose values shorter than the
migration defaults, so an operator can tighten but never extend evidence life.
ProductOwnerReviewAgePolicy.title: ProductOwnerReviewAgePolicy

ProductOwnerSelfReviewPolicy.description:
Self-review denial policy for one product Owner scope.

Self-review is denied by default. A product policy may permit it only for
routine changes, and only through an explicitly revisioned exception. Sensitive,
unknown, and production-affecting changes are always denied.
ProductOwnerSelfReviewPolicy.title: ProductOwnerSelfReviewPolicy
